purpose: Declare kernel identity, architecture, reading order, override tiers, scope, and loading protocol.
human_note: Read this first. The kernel is GSSC's portable operating context, not a template or asset pack.

kernel_identity.name: GSSC_Kernel
source_priority: Current executed or authoritative corporate records
Older profiles, drafts, summaries, and chat memories

architecture.principle: The kernel teaches how to think and handle files; uploaded masters teach what to build.
architecture.conflict_rule: When sources conflict, do not silently choose a convenient value. Record the conflict, prefer the highest-priority verified source, and prevent lower-priority documents from overriding it.
architecture.current_release_rule: kernel_identity.kernel_version and the sole changelog entry with current_status=current identify the current production release.
architecture.package_container_rule: The kernel ships inside GSSC_Master_Package.json alongside the execution protocol, the tokenized quotation payload, the brand_assets repository and the assembly engine. Binary assets are stored exactly once in brand_assets and referenced from the template as {{GSSC_ASSET:name}} tokens; hydration per Execution Protocol Section 28C is mandatory before any render or delivery.

module_map.02_governance: active officers, future-only registry, signatory authority
module_map.07_website_doctrine: website, motion, content, and delivery doctrine (own coded site)
module_map.08_document_doctrine: profiles, letterheads, case notes, email, presentations, forms
module_map.10_template_engine: Mode A Fidelity Cloner and Mode B Deconstruction Engine
module_map.11_registry: known masters, assets, status, routing, and supersession
module_map.14_accounting_compliance: accounting controls, tax registrations, books, close, filings, evidence, and review gates
module_map.15_design_research_engine: dynamic body-content design doctrine: always-research, token-translate, memory-based precedent, self-check/self-fix
module_map.16_continuous_optimization_discipline: self-improvement governance: materiality gate distinguishing genuine optimization from preference, permanent doctrine capture, non-regression, honest self-assessment
module_map.17_numbering_and_toc_system: categorical numbering, header registers, table of contents
module_map.19_accessibility_doctrine: Document accessibility floor; honest scope of what browser print-to-PDF guarantees and what it does not.

hard_override.rule: Never silently relax; deliberate kernel revision required.

hard_default.rule: Preserve process and counsel requirements; do not invent legal conclusions.

strong_default.rule: May be intentionally varied for a named deliverable after stating the deviation.

canonical_data.rule: Change only from verified source information and version the kernel.

starter_prompt: Load GSSC_Kernel.json. Apply its identity, governance, firewall, IP, brand, quotation, website, document, legal, accounting/compliance, template, registry, and bootstrap rules. Inspect uploaded files before acting. Use Mode A for faithful HTML reproduction and Mode B for surgical deconstruction of finished authoritative HTML. Preserve source fidelity. Await my task.

does: record and resolve authoritative-source conflicts through explicit provenance
does_not: contain the actual master HTML files
contain the actual brand base64 pack
remember context not captured in the kernel or current chat
